hainrixz-all-deploy-root.description: Deploys websites, web apps, APIs, and agents to the internet with a strict pre-deploy audit and a preview → health-check → prod flow. Handles plain HTML/CSS/JS pages and static sites (Astro, Hugo, Jekyll, Eleventy, Vite) as well as Next, Remix, Nuxt, SvelteKit, FastAPI, Flask, Express, MCP servers, Claude Agent SDK scripts, Python workers, and Dockerized projects. Routes to free static hosts — Cloudflare Pages, Netlify, GitHub Pages, Render — or to Vercel, Railway, Docker+SSH VPS, or a cloudflared tunnel, and can also run the project locally. Use when the user says "/all-deploy", "/deploy",…

hainrixz-all-deploy-cowork-plugin-publis.description: Puts a web page on the internet for free, with no terminal and no paid plan — a folder of HTML/CSS/JS, or a page Claude just built. Checks the page for the things that silently break it once it's live (wrong filename, broken image paths, capitalisation that works on your computer and 404s on the host, API keys left in the JavaScript), then walks through publishing it on Cloudflare Pages, Netlify, GitHub Pages or Render, and connecting a custom domain. Use when the user says "publish my website", "put my page online", "deploy my HTML", "host my site for free", "sube mi página web", "publicar…
